## RPC handlers that can transitively trigger outbound HTTP to a user-configured webhook URL

Seven top-level `APIV1Service` RPC handlers can reach webhook delivery. User-webhook CRUD handlers (`CreateUserWebhook`, etc.) only persist configuration and do **not** perform outbound HTTP.

| RPC handler | File:line | Transitive chain to HTTP |
|---|---|---|
| **`CreateMemo`** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` | → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (:157) → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:48`) → `webhook.PostAsync` (:71) |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` | → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go:66`) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` |
| **`DeleteMemo`** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` | → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (:562) → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` | → (via internal `CreateMemo` at :56) `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` **and** → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (:119) → `webhook.PostAsync` (:43) |
| **`SetMemoAttachments`** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` | → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (:48) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` |
| **`SetMemoRelations`** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` | → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (:48) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` |

Connect/gRPC entry points delegate to these same methods via `ConnectServiceHandler` → `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`).

---

## Convergence function (before delivery)

**`webhook.PostAsync`** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`

All dispatch paths enqueue here:

```

```

`dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` handles `memos.memo.created`, `memos.memo.updated`, and `memos.memo.deleted`. `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` has its own loop but also calls the same `webhook.PostAsync`.

## Delivery (actual outbound HTTP)

**`webhook.Post`** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`

`PostAsync` enqueues to `asyncPostQueue` (:39); four worker goroutines (`init()` at :42–54) dequeue and call `Post`, which issues the HTTP POST via `safeClient.Do(req)` at line 152 to `requestPayload.URL` (the user-configured webhook URL from `store.GetUserWebhooks`).

| **Convergence** | `webhook.PostAsync` | `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` | Single enqueue point before delivery |
